Container.Name: delistd
Container.Overview: Sends GDPR and CCPA data removal requests to 700+ data brokers from your own mailbox, tracks their replies over IMAP and re-sends on a schedule. Everything stays in a local SQLite database; there is no cloud service and no telemetry. IMPORTANT: the web UI has no login and holds your mail credentials, so keep it on your LAN and never forward its port to the internet. Formerly named Eraser. Browser form-filling (the fill command) needs a separate Chromium container; see the project's Docker docs. The container runs as user 99:100, so its appdata folder must be writable by nobody.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI. It has no login: keep it on your LAN.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Config, history database, broker list and the machine ID that keys your encrypted mail passwords. Keep it across updates. The container runs as user 99 (nobody), so this folder must be writable by it: create it first, or run Docker Safe New Perms if you see permission denied. The folder name inside the container is the pre-rename one on purpose.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin, so times in the UI match your clock.

Config.Name: Chrome URL
Config.Description: Optional. Chrome DevTools endpoint of a separate Chromium container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:9222, for browser form-filling.
